title: Documentation Integrity, Link Correction & Vocabulary Harmonization

arithmetic_discrepancy.issue: Gate 19.1 summary stated 4,507 deleted lines while itemized table summed to 4,517.
arithmetic_discrepancy.resolution: Corrected in MECT_FINAL_GATE_19_1_DELETION_PRESERVATION_REPORT.md and deletion_line_count_reconciliation.json using exact Git diff numstat per file (sum = 4,507).

payment_policy_contradiction.issue: Frontend config specified manual SBI/UPI only, while earlier audit text referenced live Cashfree gateway support.
payment_policy_contradiction.resolution: Harmonized across all Gate 19.10 docs: Active production policy is manual SBI/UPI only. Cashfree and Razorpay are classified as IMPLEMENTED_BUT_INACTIVE / DORMANT_LEGACY.

portal_route_metadata_contradiction.issue: src/lib/routes.ts advertised LOGIN and REGISTER as live in footer and sitemap.
portal_route_metadata_contradiction.resolution: Updated src/lib/routes.ts to inNav: false, inFooter: false, inSitemap: false, priority: 0.0, status: 'planned'.

accessibility_statements.issue: Early reports claimed unqualified 'full WCAG 2.2 AA certification' based only on zero critical/serious violations.
accessibility_statements.resolution: Reclassified to Substantial Conformance with documented 2 moderate findings (landmark-unique, heading-order) and 20 incomplete manual review items.

e2e_journey_claims.issue: Passive element presence in DOM was previously labeled as proof of full user journeys.
e2e_journey_claims.resolution: Replaced with real interactive E2E script (scripts/test_gate_19_10_interactive_e2e.mjs) testing negative and positive form states, mock submissions, and blocked network.

file_link_cleanup.resolution: Replaced with repository-relative Markdown links (./MECT_...). Verified 0 file:/// URLs remain across docs/.

sensitive_value_redaction.issue: Full PAN and bank account numbers appeared in audit reports.
sensitive_value_redaction.resolution: Redacted to masked values (AADTM****F, ****2498) across all Gate 19.10 audit reports and machine-readable JSON exports.
